description: How TrackerHacker works and how to write hacks, mappings, rules, cards and questions, one page at a time. Pages: overview (Read first: the words (track, hack, mapping, Inbox) and the usual order of calls.); templates (Before writing or checking a text template: fields, types, date formats, skips, lists, and how to make one that lasts.); json (When messages arrive as JSON (a webhook, Zapier, a Shortcut).); mappings (Before save_hack with a mapping: field, const, negate, cents, required columns, row keys.); rules (When the person wants some rows kept out (small amounts, another account, a sender).); actions (Before set_questions or answer_question: the TH Actions tab, and how formulas ask the person things in To do.); glance (Before set_glance or reminders: the numbers a sheet shows in the app, and when the person is notified.); health (Before create_custom_track with source health: the values, parts and units, and how often a row comes.); sharing (Before building a hack (look for a shared one first), and before share_hack or share_template.); fixing (When a hack stopped matching, messages wait in the Inbox, or for a scheduled check.); privacy (What to keep out of templates and sheets, and what assistants can't do.). Leave out page for the list.
name: read_guide
title: Read the guide
